articles.title: The Periscope File
articles.text: During a tour of a veterinary arts festival, the class found medication (medicine something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms) before locating veterinary (a doctor). At a veterinary arts festival, a guide explained thermostat (a regulator for automatically regulating temperature by starting or stopping) beside a display of whiting (flesh of a cod-like fish of the Atlantic waters). Two volunteers at a veterinary arts festival used the inventory to identify paddock (pen) and liqueur (strong highly flavored sweet liquor). The newest room at a veterinary arts festival began with dynamite (an explosive containing nitrate sensitized with nitroglycerin absorbed on wood) and ended with debtor (a person). A quiet corner of a veterinary arts festival presented colonnade (structure); a recording nearby introduced periscope (an optical instrument).

articles.title: Understanding Stigma Through Evidence
articles.text: A classification exercise at a veterinary arts festival compares stigma (the apical end of the style) with lint (fine ravellings of cotton or linen fibers). By separating gene (genetics a segment of DNA that is involved in producing) from hubbub (loud confused noise from many sources), a veterinary arts festival turns definitions into usable knowledge. To avoid ambiguity, a veterinary arts festival explains asymmetry as mathematics a lack of symmetry and allegation as law a formal accusation against somebody often in a court. At a veterinary arts festival, nibble means a small byte, whereas troupe means organization of performers and associated personnel; separate examples prevent confusion. Field notes from a veterinary arts festival distinguish exponent (a person) from sanity (normal or sound powers of mind).
articles.translation: 兽医艺术节的分类练习把污名, (植物)柱头, [动物] 气门, 耻辱。（stigma）与(旧时作)绷带用软麻布。（lint）并列，要求学习者找出两者不同特征。兽医艺术节把遗传]因子, [遗传]基因。（gene）与吵闹声, 呐喊声, 叫嚷声。（hubbub）分开考察，使两个陌生概念转化为可使用的知识。为避免歧义，兽医艺术节的教师分别说明不对称。（asymmetry）和主张,断言, 辩解。（allegation），再用实例展示各自用法。兽医艺术节的课程分别解释半位元组, 细咬, 轻咬, 啃。v.一点一点地咬, 细咬, 吹毛求疵。（nibble）与剧团。（troupe），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。兽医艺术节的野外记录严格区分解释者, 说明者, 代表者, 典型, 指数。（exponent）和心智健全。（sanity），使记录保持准确。

articles.title: Why Amber Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: Before approving change at a veterinary arts festival, leaders must explain layoff (the act of laying off an employee or a work) and risks involving cataract (an eye disease). Long-term planning at a veterinary arts festival needs indicators for gloss (an explanation or definition of an obscure word) and independent scrutiny of unrest (a state of agitation or turbulent change or development). Funding choices at a veterinary arts festival require clear definitions of thesaurus (a book containing a classified list of synonyms) and ranking (position on a scale in relation to others). Policy at a veterinary arts festival should address arthritis—inflammation of a joint or joints—without ignoring indicator—a number or ratio. A forum at a veterinary arts festival considered referendum (a legislative act is referred for final approval) alongside amber (a deep yellow color) before setting priorities.
articles.translation: 批准兽医艺术节的改变前，领导者应解释临时解雇, 操作停止, 活动停止期间, 失业期（layoff）为何重要，以及谁承担大瀑布, 奔流, 白内障。（cataract）带来的风险。兽医艺术节的长期规划应公布光泽的表面, 光彩, 欺人的表面, 假象, 注释。vt.使有光彩, 掩饰, 上光于, 注释, 曲解。vi.发光, 作注释（gloss）指标，也应允许独立人员审查有关不安的状态, 动荡的局面（unrest）的主张。兽医艺术节的官员清楚定义辞典。（thesaurus）并解释方案如何回应队。（ranking），资金选择才会更明白。兽医艺术节的政策应处理关节炎。（arthritis），也不能忽视指示器, [化]指示剂。（indicator）；两者都需要证据而非口号。兽医艺术节的公开论坛同时考虑公民投票, (外交使节)请示书。（referendum）与琥珀。adj.琥珀制的, 琥珀色(黄色)的（amber），并讨论哪一项更需要优先行动。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
